sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Second Amendment Ordinance 1998
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

PAKISTAN WATER AND POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE XXI OF 1998
PAKISTAN WATER AND POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1998
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Water and Power Development
Authority Act, 1958
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd December, 1998]
F.No.2(1)/98-Pub., dated
23-12-1998.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information.
1. Short title, extent and commencement. ---(l) This Ordinance may
be called the Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (Second Amendment)
Ordinance, 1998.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Second Amendment Ordinance 1998
sections.description:
Amendment of section 8, W.P. ACT XXXI of 1958

PAKISTAN WATER AND POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE XXI OF 1998
PAKISTAN WATER AND POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1998
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Water and Power Development
Authority Act, 1958
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd December, 1998]
F.No.2(1)/98-Pub., dated
23-12-1998.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information.
2. Amendment of section 8, W.P. ACT XXXI of 1958.---(1) In the
Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958 (W.P. Act XXXI of
1958) hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 8,---
(i) in
subsection (2), in clause (vii), the words "and the National Transmission
Grid" shall be omitted;
(ii) in
subsection (5),--
(a) in clause
(d), in sub-clause (iii), the word "and" at the end shall be omitted.
(b) in clause
(e), for the full stop at the end, a semi-colon and word "; and"
shall be substituted;
(c) after
clause (e), amended as aforesaid, the following new clause shall be added,
namely:--
"(f)
notwithstanding any terms of any contract entered into by the Authority for the
supply of electricity to any person, transfer such contract to any company or
other entity promoted, formed or sponsored pursuant to a scheme framed under
clause (vii) of subsection (2).".

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Second Amendment Ordinance 1998
sections.description:
Amendment of section 17, W.P. Act XXXI of 1958

PAKISTAN WATER AND POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1998
ORDINANCE XXI OF 1998
PAKISTAN WATER AND POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1998
An Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Water and Power Development
Authority Act, 1958
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 23rd December, 1998]
F.No.2(1)/98-Pub., dated
23-12-1998.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information.
3. Amendment of section 17, W.P. Act XXXI of 1958.---In the said
Act, in section 17, after subsection (2), the following new subsection shall be
added, namely:--
"(3)
Notwithstanding anything contained in subsection (1) or any rules made or
orders or instructions issued by the Authority or in the terms and conditions
of service of any person employed by, or serving under the Authority, the
Authority may at any time, transfer, second or depute any such person to any
company or other entity promoted, formed or sponsored pursuant to a scheme
framed under clause (vii) of subsection (2) of section 8 on such terms and
conditions as it may deem fit."
